sources.snippet: GOAT mmBERT YAT Base is a multilingual encoder pretrained with masked language modeling (MLM). This release contains checkpoint 379079, following complete coverage of a prepared corpus containing 10,038,104,948 nonpadding tokens. The model has 281,834,028 parameters, including its MLM head. sources.title: mlnomad/goat-mmbert-yat-base-contrastive-10k · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The GOAT base and previous YAT columns use their published full-suite receipts on the same task and dataset revisions. The previous YAT model inherited mmBERT weights and received contrastive fine-tuning. The GOAT base received MLM pretraining, and this release adds contrastive fine-tuning to that base.
